div.head: Iud Dei VIII 2.1
div.ab: þæt, gyf ðu ænig ðing ðisse stale wite oððe gewita wære, ðonne gedylegie ðin heorte, ⁊ þis wæter ðe ne underfó;
dass, wenn du etwas von diesem Diebstahle weisst oder Mitwisser gewesen bist, dann vergehe dein Herz, und dies Wasser nehme dich nicht auf;
that, if you know anything of this theft or have been an accessory, then may your heart fail, and may this water not receive you;
if you know anything about this theft or have been an accomplice, then let your heart perish, and let not this water receive you.
